result.reason: Section 2.1 reaches the fallback: the commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, may be reduced on 30 days' notice, and uses a true-up rather than an express penalty. The edit is focused and preserves unrelated commercial terms. Drafting quality is reduced because Section 12.3 still states that no minimum-volume commitment exists, directly conflicting with revised Section 2.1, and the distinction between a true-up for the unmet amount and a take-or-pay charge could be expressed more clearly.
